caveats: ARI is primary; ACC, arithmetic NMI and arithmetic AMI are mandatory companions. No best-of-metrics ranking or winner selection.
These are inductive source-recipe adaptations, not matched-budget/model comparisons or reproductions of historical published scores.
VaDE uses one sampled Gaussian latent for native assignments; DEC/IDEC use deterministic embeddings; Pro-t native uses deterministic encoder means.
Pro-t native Student assignments and final training-fitted GMM assignments are distinct outcomes, never selected by evaluation score.
Three reference seeds are descriptive implementation checks; they are separate from the five fresh seeds of the matched core study.
DEC and IDEC share fresh seed-matched pretraining. Initialization cost is reported as a shared dependency, not counted twice as independent work.
ACC matching is evaluation-only. Mapped F1/recall use the same displayed ACC-optimal map; ambiguity is retained.
Arithmetic NMI and V-measure are equivalent; balanced accuracy is mean per-class recall. These are not independent corroborating outcomes.
Responsibility diagnostics do not establish calibrated class probabilities. No class Brier score/log-loss is computed.
No robustness effect can be inferred from clean reference endpoints. Paired corruption metrics are inapplicable here.
Unlike loss reductions and likelihoods are retained as method-specific diagnostics and are not compared as a common ELBO.

inapplicable_metrics.DEC_reconstruction_likelihood: DEC clustering has no generative likelihood
inapplicable_metrics.class_probability_scores: Arbitrary cluster responsibilities are not calibrated class probabilities
inapplicable_metrics.common_ELBO: Different model likelihoods and objective reductions

method_specific_training_diagnostics.interpretation: Recorded training quantities at the displayed update/epoch; not newly recomputed endpoint likelihoods or cross-method comparable losses

mapping.macro_average_classes: all observed truth classes; no extra unknown-label class; zero division returns zero
mapping.objective: one-to-one maximum correct count (Hungarian ACC), not purity or F1 maximization
mapping.ordering: first occurrence of observed labels; empty components excluded from matching
mapping.unmatched_prediction_policy: every observation assigned to an unmatched cluster is incorrect

probabilities.interpretation: cluster responsibilities only; no class calibration or class-probability score
probabilities.normalization: accepted rows normalized to unit mass for diagnostics

prediction_artifact.prediction_rule: frozen endpoint artifact; no refitting or re-sampling
